description: Tell us about your background, preferences, and current interests so courses can use familiar examples, explain things in a style you prefer, and present slides the way you like.

externalAgent.prompt:
Based on what you already know about me, help me write a short note that makes it easier for courses to adapt explanations to my background and preferences. Include only:
- What you usually call me
- My professional background, identity, and relevant experience
- My preferred communication style
- My preferred slide style
- What I have been focusing on recently

Write in first-person plain text, keep it within 1,000 characters, and do not guess or add details you do not actually know.
